# Token and cost matrix (generated by `copilot cost-matrix`)

Same 60 eval tickets, prompt `triage_v3`, every model. Prices: `configs/prices.yaml` (list prices; DeepSeek at peak rates, off-peak is half).

| claude-opus-5-5 | 60 | 5,634 | 5,634 | 601 | 979 | 0% | 1.00x | 1.16x |
